historian_extraordinaire_desc: Incredible! You have a historian's mind, perfectly placing events in time and space. The past holds no secrets from you!
time_travel_expert_desc: Fantastic work! You have a strong grasp of history and a great sense of time. Just a few tweaks, and you'll be a master!
history_enthusiast_desc: Well done! You're developing a keen historical sense. A little more practice, and you'll be placing events like a pro!
history_explorer_desc: You're on your way! History is vast and complex, and every attempt sharpens your skills. Keep playing and learning!
time_traveler_training_desc: Don't be discouraged! Even the greatest historians had to start somewhere. Keep playing, and history will reveal its patterns to you!
perfect_score_bonus_desc: Earn an extra 100 points if all cards are placed correctly.
hint_penalty_desc: Using a hint reduces the points earned per correct card by 50%.
difficulty_scaling_desc: The hard mode offers 150% more points per correctly placed card.
partial_accuracy_desc: Even if your placements aren’t perfect, you’ll still earn partial points based on accuracy.
history_unfolds: History unfolds one day at a time! Return tomorrow for new events from the past.
come_back_tomorrow: Come back tomorrow to play again!
